item.text: The campaign is live with a $400 lifetime cap and $34 daily pacing. It targets Ireland and the UK on iOS and Android, with climbing keywords, and uses three approved posts covering the seasonal message, app features, and price. The schedule runs through midnight after August 10 in Dublin time.

After three days, X reports $86.23 spent and 45 link clicks. The seasonal post has the lowest cost per click so far, but the sample is small. I’m slightly increasing daily pacing to keep the flight on track, while retaining the $400 total cap.

At the halfway point, spend is $186.49 with 83 link clicks. The seasonal and price posts have similar costs per click; there isn’t a clear enough difference to justify replacing the current mix. Delivery is on pace within the total budget.
